title: A Comparative Analysis of Ethical and Safety Gaps in LLMs using Relative Danger Coefficient

live_model.evidence: "We systematically stress-tested several state-of-the-art models, including the GPT family... GPT-4 Turbo3" (Intro); Sec 4.3 reports Relative Danger Coefficient (RDC) by category

prompt.location: Sec 3.1 (RDC formula), Appendix A/B (prompt/category details referenced)
prompt.note: Prompts probe Hate Speech, Self-Harm, Weapons, Crime, and Substance categories with adversarial/harmful scenarios.

claim.location: Sec 4.3 (charts/figures per category); no consolidated per-model table found

data.source: Author-constructed adversarial prompt set (categories inspired by Tedeschi et al. 2024), not stated as released

notes: This is a red-teaming/jailbreak-style safety study (prompts elicit hate speech, self-harm, weapons, crime, and substance-abuse content); such prompts should not be re-run against a commercial API regardless of other reproducibility factors.
